description: This Java interface defines a contract for responses to live commands within the Eclipse Ditto framework, specifically for classes implementing 'LiveCommandAnswer'. It includes methods for retrieving a response and an event related to the command.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the CommandResponse associated with this answer, or empty if none exists.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the Event associated with this answer, or empty if none exists.
